personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK with 7 Dark-First Utility fusion
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, obsidian-and-gold chess arena combining tactile precision, deep tactical stats, and elite dark luxury.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room with 16pt cards, 24pt screen margins, and clean touch targets ≥44pt.

do's: Use translucent dark frosted glass for floating bottom navigation
Apply glass blur overlay on active match cards and timer badges
Use gold glow accents on selected pieces and win states
dont's: Never blur body text or form inputs
Never exceed 2 blur surfaces in vertical hierarchy

screens.name: LoginAuth
screens.purpose: Authenticate user via Email/Password or Instant Guest Mode with obsidian-gold luxury branding.

states.loading: Centered gold pulsing chess knight loader
states.error: Inline toast banner with error description and retry

screens.layout: Full-bleed dark background with subtle gold radial vignette, centered branding monogram, segmented Login/Register tabs, clean input fields with icons, and 'Continue as Guest' secondary action.

screens.name: HomeDashboard
screens.purpose: Central lobby showing user Elo rating, daily challenge card, quick play modes, and recent activity.

states.loading: Skeleton card placeholders with shimmer effect
states.empty: No recent matches message with 'Play First Match' CTA
states.error: Card banner showing connection retry button

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with safe area top. Header with greeting, avatar, and Elo badge. Featured Daily Challenge hero card with gold border. Grid of 4 game modes (Computer, Online, Pass & Play, Puzzles). Bottom sticky navigation bar.

screens.name: MatchScreen
screens.purpose: The core interactive chess arena featuring custom board, piece movement, move sound effects, timer, hints, and analysis tools.

states.loading: Board setup spinner with custom piece assets

screens.layout: Top opponent bar with timer and captured pieces. Central responsive Chessboard with 8x8 squares, move highlights, and drag-and-drop piece interaction. Bottom player bar, timer, action tray (Undo, Hint, Resign, Settings), and Move confirmation toggle.

screens.name: PuzzleDaily
screens.purpose: Daily tactical challenges and puzzle rush for skill training.

states.error: Failed to load puzzles retry button

screens.layout: Header streak counter, featured tactical puzzle card with difficulty badge, interactive mini-board, and hint/solution action buttons.

screens.name: LeaderboardProfile
screens.purpose: User profile with match statistics, win-loss record, and global Elo leaderboard.

states.loading: Profile skeleton loader with stats card placeholders
states.error: Failed to fetch stats retry button

screens.layout: Profile header with custom avatar, title, and Elo rating graph. Tabbed view switching between Match History list and Global Leaderboard rankings.

screens.name: SettingsCustomisation
screens.purpose: Comprehensive settings for board/piece themes, audio move sounds, haptics, and engine strength.
screens.layout: Categorized list rows with section headers: Audio & Haptics toggles, Board Themes (Obsidian Gold, Classic Wood, Emerald Marble), Piece Styles, and Account Management.

hero_board_bg.alt: Luxury obsidian dark gold chess board

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screens strictly adhere to the Luxury Gold & Dark theme (#0E1013 surface, #D4AF37 gold accents). Implement haptics on move actions, move audio effects on legal piece drops, timer countdowns, and MongoDB-backed state handling. Use MaterialCommunityIcons for all icon elements and avoid any banned blue/indigo/purple hues.
